title: Chapter 99 — CRM Leverage and The Analyst Sessions
intro: Friction-free capture, file synthesis, and pattern-mining.

sections.title: AI Makes CRM Useful
sections.content:
Most salespeople hate CRM because it feels like data entry with no payoff. AI changes that equation. Use AI to draft CRM entries from notes. Use AI to analyze your CRM data for patterns — which customers are due for follow-up, which product categories are trending, where your pipeline is weak.

The CRM becomes a strategic tool instead of a compliance task.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating CRM leverage, ask:

Is the salesperson using AI to reduce CRM friction — or still treating it as a chore?
Are they mining CRM data for insights — or just logging activity?
Is the CRM producing actionable intelligence — or sitting dormant?
